entities.summary: Historic (1885-1948) name for minor kingdoms (analogous to princely state of british india) ruled by saopha (similar to thai royal title chao fa prince/princess) in areas of today's burma, china, laos and northern thailand from c.1215 to c.1959 Founded 1215.
